##### Project general facts

Montenapoleone is a residential compound developed by Reportage Properties in partnership with Al Ahly Sabbour Development, part of a wider mixed-use masterplan built across several phases. The community combines townhouse clusters rising across a ground and two upper floors, low-rise residential buildings of up to six floors offering simplex and duplex apartments, and sky villa units, alongside a dedicated commercial building line. Residence formats include townhouses, simplex and duplex apartments, and sky villas, positioned as an Italian-inspired residential offering built around shared green space.

The community amenities include restaurants, a shopping centre with retail stores, a hypermarket, F&B outlets, a cigar club, squash courts, a tennis court, football courts, a sports complex, a swimming pool, parks and playgrounds, a clubhouse, and a pharmacy, together with dedicated basement parking and private parking lots. Green and open space accounts for a significant share of the overall community footprint.

Units feature kitchen cabinets and countertops, fully tiled bathrooms with bathtub or shower, built-in wardrobes in the bedrooms, balconies and terraces as per unit plan, and fibre-optic infrastructure for high-speed internet. Exteriors draw on modern Italian architectural references, combining minimal forms with rich material finishing. The units are delivered unfurnished.


##### Location description and benefits

Mostakbal City is a forward-thinking master-planned destination positioned to become one of the most promising residential hubs in eastern Cairo. Strategically located between New Cairo and the New Administrative Capital, the area is designed with a strong focus on modern infrastructure, expansive green spaces, and well-organized communities. It offers a balanced lifestyle that combines urban convenience with a sense of openness and tranquility, making it highly attractive for both living and long-term investment.

The city is home to a growing collection of contemporary residential developments, ranging from apartments to villas within gated communities, all supported by a carefully planned network of amenities. Its proximity to key destinations such as New Cairo and the New Administrative Capital ensures easy access to business districts, educational institutions, and lifestyle attractions. Wide roads, landscaped parks, retail zones, and community facilities are seamlessly integrated to create a self-sustained and comfortable environment.

Excellent connectivity further enhances Mostakbal City’s appeal, with direct links to major highways that provide smooth access across Greater Cairo. The area continues to witness rapid development and increasing demand, driven by its strategic location and future-ready vision. With its modern planning, growing infrastructure, and investment potential, Mostakbal City stands out as a key destination for a new generation of urban living in Egypt.
